programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Tarik Khbabez (52-12-1, 22 KO) and Bahram Rajabzabeh (72-5, 63 KO) collide in a huge showdown for the vacant Light Heavyweight title. The penultimate round of the Last Heavyweight Standing tournament resumes with eight heavyweights competing in two separate four-man one-night tournaments. Notable participants include Levi Rigters (20-3, 10 KO), Nabil Khachab (30-6-1, 4 KO), Rade Opacic (22-7, 17 KO) and Milos Cvjeticanin (14-4, 9 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY heavyweight world champion Mory Kromah (37-3-1, 21 KO) defends his title against Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (19-5, 10 KO), Croatian superstar Antonio Plazibat (23-5, 16 KO) faces Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (49-5, 37 KO) and the GLORY light heavyweight grand prix plays out in full, deciding the next GLORY light heavyweight world champion.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY welterweight world champion Chico Kwasi (45-6-2, 23 KO) will step up in weight to challenge GLORY middleweight world champion Donovan Wisse (23-1, 10 KO) in the main event of GLORY 107. In the co-main event, giants Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (30-5-1, 17 KO) and Nico ‘Big Sexy’ Horta (26-11, 4 KO) will square off in a highly anticipated rematch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its main course day for the North West chefs Mary Ellen McTague, James Durrant and Mark Ellis. After yesterdays disastrous fish course theyre all desperate to impress the veteran judge. But who will perfectly redeem themselves?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the North West chefs last chance to impress with their desserts as at the end of todays cooking one chef must leave the competition. The pressure is on as any slip up may cost the chefs a place in tomorrows regional final.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two remaining North West chefs cook their four courses again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort, who must decide which chef will win a place in the finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E31 London and South East Starter
programme.desc: Three of London and the South Easts superstar chefs, returning contender Adam Simmonds, Michelin-starred newcomer Tom Sellers and his former boss Adam Byatt, attempt to dazzle the mystery judge with their starter courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E32 London and South East Fish
programme.desc: Today the London and South East chefs, returning contender Adam Simmonds, Michelin starred newcomer Tom Sellers and his former boss Adam Byatt continue their battle.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E33 London and South East Mains
programme.desc: The London and South East chefs Adam Simmonds, Tom Sellers and Adam Byatt go head to head cooking their main courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E34 London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: Today its dessert course as the London and South East chefs compete for one of two places in the judges chamber tomorrow and the competition couldnt be tighter. Whoever scores the lowest will be going home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E35 London and South East Judging
programme.desc: Its a tightly fought battle today as the two remaining London and South East chefs cook all four of their dishes again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of the Central regions top chefs, returning champion Aktar Islam, Daniel Cliffords protg Mark Poynton and ambitious newcomer Jason Hodnett go into battle.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning champion Aktar Islam, Daniel Cliffords protg Mark Poynton and ambitious newcomer Jason Hodnett fight it out for fish course glory. After plating up late yesterday will Aktar manage to be on time today?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the Central region chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poynton and Jason Hodnett go head to head cooking their main courses for the veteran judge. With Mark and Aktar fighting for the lead can Jason sneak under the radar to take them by surprise?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its dessert day and the Central chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poyton and Jason Hodnett are all striving for one of two spots in tomorrows regional final. Will Jasons elaborate chocolate medal dessert see him triumph or sent home empty handed?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two remaining Central region chefs cook all four courses again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. At the end of the day one chef will advance to the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it's the starter course and as the chefs arrive they discover there's added competition following the London and South East region's shock result.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the fish course and those chefs who didnt make it onto the shortlist with their starters yesterday are hoping to do better today. Who will be in with a chance of cooking their fish course at the banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the half-way point in finals week and those chefs who have yet to get a dish onto the shortlist are feeling the heat. With nine dishes tasted and the scores in, theres a shock result for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: When the Dessert result is in its down to the judges to pick the perfect menu from all four courses shortlists. Which chef will triumph to cook the starter, fish, main and dessert at the D Day banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. Its the culmination of months of hard work as the winning four chefs strive to deliver their dishes to an expectant audience of wartime heroes at St Paul's Cathedral, a bastion of British wartime resilience.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three top chefs from Scotland all competition newcomers are out to impress this weeks veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of Scotlands finest chefs are competing to be crowned champion. All week Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today one chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a very difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood inspired by a local hero honoured by the Queen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. Scotlands two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it is the starter course of the South West Regional heat. Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Josh is the Michelin star chef proprietor at The Pony and Trap near Bristol.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu today as the three chefs from the South West a region renowned for its seafood - tackle the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The South West regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort and today they are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UKs leading culinary talents Simon Rogan, heading up Simons The French restaurant at Manchesters Midland hotel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning NW champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. Last year his fish course was shortlisted for the banquet in the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting highly creative producing some of the most original and stunning desserts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Its the dessert course that seals the fate of the chefs and the North West Champion is revealed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael and Adam Bannister. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. Adam Bannister has created a modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Returning Chef, Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an O.B.E, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week in the Welsh heat newcomer Andrew Birch is challenging two returning chefs, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael. It is the dessert course and one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional Central champion - Daniel Smith, Andrew Scott and Danny Gill. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Cliffords two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UKs best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Daniel Smith may be classically trained but hes decided to take a risk adding a cheese custard to his lobster dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queens Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. Today one competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. And the chefs are pushing themselves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The Central regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E26 London and South East Starter
programme.desc: Today three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E27 London and South East Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E28 London and South East Main
programme.desc: Its the all important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Hes showcasing British Rose veal and celebrating the determination of British producers to bounce back from disaster.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E29 London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South Easts most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E30 London and South East Judging
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as Guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the North East Regional title but hes competing against two young newcomers Tommy Banks and Chris Archer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs from the North East, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the main course of the North East Region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. Its a tough and emotional day for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own Great Briton, his late Grandfather.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for the judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Joining them is guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive Head Chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three top chefs from Northern Ireland are competing for a place in the National Finals. There are some varied and exciting starters, as the chefs get creative. And theres real shock and emotion as the veteran chef delivers his scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more competitive as the three chefs from Northern Ireland dish cook their fish courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for an historic score, he could beat his boss a veteran of GBM and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the National Finals of Great British Menu. The chefs will mark each course of the fellow chefs dishes; the average of their scores will be added to the judges scores. There are some shocks and surprises as the chefs opinions differ from the judges.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is day two of Great British Menus National Finals. Today the eight champions will cook their fish courses. Two chefs have reason to be confident after scoring tens from every judge in the heats. Can they deliver a perfect dish second time round?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 On Your Mark, Get Set, Duel!
programme.desc: Within Satellite, a location segregated from a luxurious utopia, New Domino City; lies Yusei Fudo, a young duelist and Duel Runner enthusiast who is plotting revenge against his rival and former friend, Jack Atlas, the current King of New Domino City in an attempt to reclaim his stolen Duel Runner and "Stardust Dragon" card. However, Yusei must first deal with Sector Security as they attempt to arrest his friend Rally Dawson for stealing a Duel Runner piece for Yusei's Duel Runner.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei reminisces about the past whilst developing his Duel Runner in preparation for sneaking into New Domino City and reclaiming what was stolen from him. In the meantime, Blitz, Nervin and Tank become involved in a fight with Lenny, Lug and Larry who then turn up at Yusei's hideout and demand his Duel Runner. To protect his friends and their bonds, Yusei duels Lenny with his Duel Runner on the line.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The time has finally arrived for Yusei to sneak into New Domino City so he can settle the score with Jack and reclaim what was stolen from him. However, Tetsu Trudge interrupts Yusei's plan and uses the imposed "Speed World" to force Yusei into a Turbo Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 A Blast from the Past, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei finally manages to meet Jack in New Domino. Here, they hold a Turbo Duel with Yusei's "Stardust Dragon" on the line. Yusei is determine to have his card back and get his revenge on his former friend.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 A Blast from the Past, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Turbo Duel with Jack after Jack has managed to Summon both their aces "Red Dragon Archfiend" and "Stardust Dragon". Yusei is able to gain control of "Stardust Dragon" with "Harmonia Mirror". But unknown to them, the summoning of the two dragons trigger an event that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo has been caught by the Sector Security and sent to the Facility. In the paddy wagon, he meets a man called Tenzen Yanagi whom he befriends. The former Pro Duelist, Bolt Tanner, meets Yusei there. Tanner challenges Yusei, who is unable to Duel since he doesn't have a Deck. As a result, Yanagi Duels in his place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Disgusted by Tanner speaking ill of Yanagi's cards and stomping on them, Yusei Duels Tanner using Yanagi's Deck, in order to teach him that no card is truly unneeded (in the dub he wanted to teach him what respect really means).

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Securities examine Yusei's body for confirmation of his Mark of the Dragon. Meanwhile, Jack has learned of the legend of the Crimson Dragon and forces himself to obey Goodwin and hosts a Turbo Duel between him and Hunter Pace, who wants a rematch with him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 The Lockdown Duel, Part 1
programme.desc: Mr. Armstrong harasses Yusei's friends in front of him and Yusei duels Armstrong with his freedom and the safety of his friends on the line. Armstrong has seized all of Yusei's Decks so Yusei duels him using cards given to him from his friends at the Facility.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 The Lokcdown Duel, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Duel with Mr. Armstrong, using cards given to him by inmates at the Facility. Despite Armstrong's brutal attack, Yusei refuses to abandon his friends and lose his freedom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 The Take Back, Part 1
programme.desc: In order to get back his Deck and Duel Runner, Yusei meets a man named Blister, but he is soon pursued by Trudge, who still wants to get his revenge on Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 The Take Back, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei, who got back his Duel Runner and his Deck, continued his Turbo Duel with Trudge. Blister, who is witnessing the Turbo Duel, does not understand why Yusei is so determined to retrieve his "Bonds of Friendship".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 A Duel to Remember
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo is left unconscious after his harsh Duel with Trudge. The twins Leo and Luna rescue him. After Yusei regains consciousness, Leo demands a Duel with him. Meanwhile, Trudge waits outside in the hopes of capturing Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Bloom of the Black Rose
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo decides to enter the Fortune Cup, after Lazar blackmailed him to do so, if he wants to see his friends at Satellite alive. On his way, he meets up with his old friends from the Facility, Bolt Tanner and Yanagi and his new friend, Leo at the Daimon Area. Leo and his friend Dexter went to the Daimon Area in order to challenge the mysterious Black Rose.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Welcome to the Fortune Club
programme.desc: The Fortune Cup has now begun. The first Duel is Luna vs. Greiger. But since Luna doesn't want to participate, Leo disguises himself and Duels in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Battle With the Black Rose
programme.desc: Luna and Dexter try to cheer up Leo after his loss to Greiger. They approach Yusei, who tells him the experience he got from losing should prove useful later on. Leo encourages Yusei to win, just before Akiza passes them. She glares intensely at Yusei as she passes. The other three quickly step out of her way. Leo wonders what her problem is.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Hunter Pace, under the disguise of Shira, Duels Yusei Fudo in the Fortune Cup, using a Deck he's designed to use against Jack Atlas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Return to the Spirit World, Part 1
programme.desc: Due to Rex Goodwin's special permission, a consolation game is to be held. Luna is called to participate. Leo is unable to substitute and Luna reluctantly comes forward. Her opponent, Professor Frank, has a trip to the Duel Monsters Spirit World planned.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Return to the Spirit World, Part 2
programme.desc: Luna engages in her Duel with Professor Frank when she is called by a mysterious voice to protect the Duel Monsters Spirit World Seeing the turmoil evildoers are doing to this land, Luna must take all her courage and skill at hand to defeat Frank's trump card.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Second Round Showdown, Part 1
programme.desc: The first day of the Fortune Cup comes to a close. Before their Duel begins tomorrow, Yusei and Greiger have a friendly talk during the night.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Second Round Showdown, Part 2
programme.desc: Determined to carry out his mission to his hometown, Greiger uses "Flying Fortress SKY FIRE" to run Yusei down. In response, Yusei reads Greiger's strategy and looks for his chance to counterattack.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The second round of the finals pits Akiza Izinski against Commander Koda. Koda begins his strategy of tormenting Akiza with her record of the past 16 years, in which flashbacks of Akiza's life are shown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Duel of the Dragons, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo confronts and questions Akiza Izinski on why she calls the Mark of the Dragon a "wretched mark". During the Duel against her, Yusei is filled with various doubts about Akiza.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 Duel of the Dragons, Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Akiza Izinski continues. Unconvinced that Akiza truly takes pleasure in bringing pain on others, he tries to reach through to her and get her to admit this and realize that she can think for herself.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 The Fortune Cup Finale, Part 1
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Jack Atlas in the Fortune Cup can begin. During the Duel, Jack remembers what drove him to go to New Domino City with Yusei's old Duel Runner and the "Stardust Dragon" card in the first place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 The Fortune Cup Finale, Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Jack Atlas heats up. Even though the Signers are transported into the past that is related to the Crimson Dragon, Jack is still determined to win the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 A Web of Deceit, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei, winner of the Fortune Cup and the appearance of the Crimson Dragon, catches the interest of the media and the mysterious organization, called the Dark Signers. One of these Dark Signers challenges Yusei to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E28 A Web of Deceit, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo continues his Duel with the man with the spider mark. His opponent reveals himself to be a Dark Signer. The reporter Carly Carmine tries to get a scoop as she watches the Duel. Meanwhile the other Dark Signers influence people to stand with them in their fight against the Crimson Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 Good Cop, Bad Cop
programme.desc: After his Duel with Grady, Yusei is willingly arrested by Trudge and Sector Security. Meanwhile, Carly, disguised as a nurse, tries to interview Jack at the hospital. Possessed by the Spider mark, Trudge appears and challenges Jack and Carly to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Crow steals a number of Decks at a Security warehouse and plans his escape on a Duel Runner. Meanwhile, Goodwin tells Yusei about the Dark Signers, and Mina and Trudge look into Jack's disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei has managed to reunite with his friend Crow Hogan, who tells him about some disturbance coming from the inner part of Satellite. Meanwhile, Jack Atlas and Carly Carmine spend the day at an amusement park, unaware that they are being followed by Mina and Trudge.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, Crow, Rally and the others meet together at Daedalus Bridge, Crow's hideout and Crow tells them the story of the legendary man of Daedalus Bridge. Meanwhile, in town, a baffling incident involving the Nazca Lines disappearing has occurred. Yusei sets his eyes on the backwoods of Satellite, the B.A.D. Area, so he can come face-to-face with a Dark Signer, namely Kalin Kessler, who seems to know Yusei very well.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Dark Signer Kalin Kessler is revealed to be an old friend of Yusei Fudo back in Satellite. However, for some unknown reason, he holds a deep hatred towards Yusei, Crow and Jack. To make matters worse, he has joined the Dark Signers whose plan is to destroy the world. Now, in order to settle things straight, Yusei and Kalin engage in a Duel while using the great picture as a stage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Dark Signer Kalin Kessler and Yusei Fudo continue their Duel. Kalin then Summons his trump card, the Dark Synchro Monster "One Hundred-Eyed Dragon", hoping to get rid of his former friend once and for all. Also, flashbacks are shown that reveal why Kalin hates his former team.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei and Kalin continues. Yusei Summons "Stardust Dragon" in order to defeat "One Hundred-Eyed Dragon". However, Kalin smirks and holds up another trump card, "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei is taken by Crow to Martha's refuge to treat his injuries from his Duel with Kalin. Meanwhile, Leo insists that the Signers should all collaborate to fight against the Dark Signers and suggests they contact Arcadia Movement in seek of Akiza's co-operation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: In fear of losing all connections with Jack, Carly continues her investigation into the Signers and Dark Signers. This leads her to the Arcadia Movement, unaware that she has a date with Destiny.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Carly Carmine, who has been thrown off the Arcadia Movement building to her death as a result of her Duel with Sayer, has come back to life as a Dark Signer, seeking revenge. Meanwhile, Misty Tredwell, after sensing that Carly has fully become a Dark Signer, goes to the Arcadia Movement to Duel Akiza Izinski as she desires revenge of her own. With both Dark Signers ready to wreak both havoc and vengeance, the countdown to the extinction of the Psychic Duelists seems to have begun!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Misty and Carly continue their Duels against Akiza and Sayer, respectively.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E40 Clash of the Dragons, Part 1
programme.desc: Akiza Izinski is left in an unconscious state after the attack on the Arcadia Movement. Unable to open Akiza's heart, due to their past treatment of Akiza, her parents ask Yusei Fudo for help.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E41 Clash of the Dragons, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei and Akiza's Duel continues. Akiza continues to inflict pain to Yusei. But despite the pain, Yusei is still determined to bring Akiza out of her sorrow.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E42 The Signs of Time
programme.desc: Rex Goodwin invites the Signers to his home and reveals to them the secret of the Crimson Dragon, as well as the connection between the Signers and the Dark Signers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E43 Surely, You Jest, Part 1
programme.desc: While the Signers must make their decision to whether or not they must battle the Dark Signers, Crow encounters Lazar in Satellite and challenges him to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E44 Surely, You Jest, Part 2
programme.desc: Crow and Lazar continue their Duel, with Crow still thinking Lazar is a Dark Signer, while the Signers prepare to travel to Satellite to face the Dark Signers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E45 Mark of the Spider, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei and the other Signers visit Martha in Satellite, but Roman interrupts their visit, challenging Yusei to a Shadow Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E46 Mark of the Spider, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei and Roman continue their Duel. Roman pushes Yusei to despair, by revealing information about his past and putting his friends in danger.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E47 Mark of the Monkey, Part 1
programme.desc: While the Signers decide to fight each Dark Signer on their battle ground, Luna is unexpectedly sent to the Duel Monsters Spirit World, leaving Leo to fight Devack in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E48 Mark of the Monkey, Part 2
programme.desc: While Luna continues her searches for Regulus in the Spirit World with the help of Torunka, Leo continues his Duel against Devack while managing to Synchro Summon his ace card, "Power Tool Dragon".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E49 Mark of the Monkey, Part 3
programme.desc: Luna, Torunka, and Regulus confront Zeman the Ape King, the Duel Monster spirit who has taken the Ancient Fairy Dragon captive. Meanwhile, in the human world, Devack manages to Summon "Zeman the Ape King" in his Duel against Leo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E50 Mark of the Monkey, Part 4
programme.desc: After defeating Zeman the Ape King and saving Ancient Fairy Dragon, Luna arrives in the human world just in time to help her brother Leo win his Duel against Devack, who has just Summoned "Earthbound Immortal Cusillu".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E51 A Whale of a Ride, Part 1
programme.desc: With Devack defeated, Roman Goodwin turns Greiger into a Dark Signer. Crow, who survived the black fog, challenges Greiger to a Duel to avenge the children who disappeared in the fog.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E51 A Whale of a Ride, Part 1
programme.desc: With Devack defeated, Roman Goodwin turns Greiger into a Dark Signer. Crow, who survived the black fog, challenges Greiger to a Duel to avenge the children who disappeared in the fog.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E52 A Whale of a Ride, Part 2
programme.desc: Crow and Greiger continue their Duel while Yusei tries to stop it. During the Duel, Crow remembers his childhood in which he learned the importance of strategy and friendship.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E53 A Whale of a Ride, Part 3
programme.desc: Greiger manages to Summon "Earthbound Immortal Chacu Challhua" in his Duel against Crow, but the latter has more tricks up his sleeve.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E54 A Score To Settle, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei and Kalin meet up again and prepare for their rematch. During their Duel, more details of their past as members of The Enforcers are revealed and how their group disbanded.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E55 A Score To Settle, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei and Kalin continue their Duel and Kalin hopes to win against his former friend with "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu". Despite this, Yusei is determined to save his friend. The powers of the Crimson Dragon enable him to call forth a new monster, "Majestic Star Dragon".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei confronts Roman at the original Ener-D Reactor and Duels him. During the Duel, Roman reveals another secret in which neither Yusei, nor his friends expected to hear.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Roman reveals to Yusei, Trudge, Leo and Luna that he was the fifth Signer, which shocks everyone, as well as how the former fifth Signer corrupted himself and became a Dark Signer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E58 Shadows of Doubt, Part 1
programme.desc: Jack finds Carly at the Hummingbird Tower. However, Jack hesitates to attack her and Carly uses a special card on Jack to make him see of what the future might be if he loses the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E59 Shadows of Doubt, Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Jack and Carly continues. When Carly seems to regain her senses, the spirit of the "Earthbound Immortal" takes control of her so that the Duel can continue. Now, Jack's only hope lies in the power of the Crimson Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E60 Truth and Consequences, Part 1
programme.desc: Akiza confronts Misty at the Lizard Tower. Meanwhile, Sayer, who survived the destruction of his Arcadia Movement Headquarters, uses his psychic powers to control Akiza so he can use her to defeat Misty.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E61 Truth and Consequences, Part 2
programme.desc: Sayer continues to manipulate Akiza in her Duel against Misty. Now, only Yusei can stop him by forcing him to reveal the truth about what really happened to Misty's brother the day of his death.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E62 Signs of Doom, Part 1
programme.desc: The King of the Netherworld arises from B.A.D. and approaches New Domino City. Rex Goodwin, who tries to use the powers of both a Signer and a Dark Signer to become a God, engages in a Turbo Duel with Yusei, Jack and Crow.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E63 Signs of Doom, Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei, Jack, Crow, and Rex Goodwin continues. Rex Summons "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" and uses its effect to reduce Crow's Life Points to 1. Due to massive injuries, Crow is unable to continue the Duel after falling off his Duel Runner.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E64 Signs of Doom, Part 3
programme.desc: Due to the effect of "Wiraqocha Rasca", Jack is blasted from the Duel. Now, only Yusei can save the world from Goodwin and stop the King of the Netherworld from reaching New Domino City.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Swing Into Action- Part 1
programme.desc: Yuya Sakaki aims to become an "Entertainment Duelist". He practices dueling every day alongside his childhood friend, Yuzu. One day, he receives a challenge for an exhibition match from the Pro Duelist, "Strong Ishijima". Although Yuya excitedly fends off his attacks in their Action Duel, he's eventually pushed into a corner.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Swing Into Action- Part 2
programme.desc: With The Sledgehammer set to strike, Yuya uses Pendulum power to swing the duel his way! Can this phenomenal new summoning method help Yuya hammer the Hammer?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It could be curtains for Yuya when a rival student cons him out of his Pendulum Cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Still shocked by Sylvio's Pendulum Summon, Yuya must find his focus if he wants to save his friends from a 100-story drop!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide

Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger

Her life becomes in danger when her doctor is kidnapped by the murderous outlaw Clay Allison.Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Jack Kelly, Paul Farber, Frank Fenton, and Fred Sherman.Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: A railroad detective pursues the infamous female outlaw, Belle Starr, after a herd of horses are stolen from the U.S. Calvalry. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Belle Starr is played by Mary Windsor. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as railroad detective Matt Clark who needs to track down a group of cattle rustlers along with their notorious leader Billy the Kid (played by Richard Jaeckel).This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook come across a girl in the woods who is running away from a man named Stark. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help an old woman find her son who has been missing for 18 years.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook go undercover as managers of a trading post. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: A trader ignites a war between the Hurons and the settlers. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: After a long winter, the Tuscarora tribe struggles for survival. Hawkeye and Chingachcook set out to help.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Tribesmen war over the daughter of a Mingo Chief. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter essentials are stolen on their way to a village. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.desc: A mother warns her popular son away from a new girlfriend, convinced she is dangerous to both of them.

programme.title: Maria My Love
programme.desc: A young woman named Ana is struggling to deal with her mother's death and her father's mistakes. In an effort to feel better, she reconnects with her half-sister Grace, (Lauren Fales) and, inspired by a new boyfriend (Brian Rieger), sets out on a quest to find someone to help. Though excited and hopeful when she meets an eccentric woman named Maria (Karen Black), she soon discovers Maria is a compulsive hoarder, and is swept up in a situation more emotionally and morally complicated than she had expected to find. Inspired by a true story.

programme.desc: An online stalker torments a young woman.

programme.desc: A singer/songwriter leaves her dreams behind to help her family, until one special guy and a group of musically-challenged strangers help her find her voice again.

programme.title: Pure Country 2: The Gift
programme.desc: Three angels bestow the gift of song to a young girl, who must follow a series of rules in order hold on to it during her rise to fame and fortune.

programme.desc: Riley wants to rebuild her bond with her mom and sick sister, but uncovers a secret that changes everything.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Vicki looks into several murders in an affluent neighborhood.

programme.title: Manden uden fortid
programme.desc: En mand er på vej til Helsingfors for at søge job. Han er knap steget af toget før han bliver røvet og mishandlet. Da han kommer til sig selv, har han mistet alt, selv sin hukommelse. Uden navn og identitet må han begynde livet på ny.

programme.title: Gasolin'
programme.desc: Et intimt portræt af Danmarks mest indflydelsesrige rockband Gasolin'. For første gang siden de gik fra hinanden i 1978 reflekterer de fire bandmedlemmer over deres karriere og hvorfor de gik fra hinanden.

programme.title: Miraklet i Le Havre
programme.desc: I den finske film 'Miraklet i Le Havre' har den tidligere forfatter og nuværende boheme Marcel Marx slået sig ned i den nordfranske havneby Le Havre. Her lever han et stille liv mellem bistroen, arbejdet og kæresten Arletty. En dag lander den afrikanske dreng Idrissa på hans dørtrin.

programme.title: Christmas Story
programme.desc: Da den unge Nikolas bliver forældreløs, bliver han adopteret af hvert hus i hans landsby i et år. Efter at han forlader huset, giver han dem en julegave og fortsætter traditionen, selv efter han er blevet voksen.

programme.title: Storm
programme.desc: Freddy redder en hund fra dens ustabile ejer og gemmer den på sit værelse. Da Freddys far opdager hunden, insisterer han på at give den tilbage til ejeren. En skrækslagen Freddy overbeviser sin far om, at de skal købe hunden.

programme.title: The Fat & The Angry - Part 1
programme.desc: Anmelderrost, brutalt gangsterdrama af Johan Renck! FBI og Interpol får nys om en stor sag om kreditkortsvindel, og narkomanen Sebbe hentes ind som mistænkt. Da politiet påbegynder afhøringen, får de en utrolig historie fra Göteborgs underverden at høre.

programme.title: Liza Marklund: Nobels Testamente
programme.desc: En gallaklædt kvinde sniger sig ind til Nobelfesten i Stockholm, og midt på dansegulvet skyder hun den israelske prisvinder og nobelkomiteens formand.

programme.title: Borkmanns Punkt
programme.desc: Derude et sted gemmer der sig en morder, der efterhånden føler sig mere og mere sikker. Kaalbringen, en lille, europæisk kystby er lammet af skræk. Maardamligeså. Inden for kort tid er de to byer blevet ramt af to brutale mord. Hvornår og hvorvil ”Halshuggeren” slåtil igen?

programme.title: Lindell - Nattens Søster - Del 1
programme.desc: Brenda Elise Moen bliver skuddræbt uden for sit hjem i Ullevål Hageby, tilsyneladende uden noget motiv. Cato Isaksen og hans team bliver sat på sagen. Efterhånden opdager politiet, at også Brenda Elises barnebarn, den 14-årige Kathrine Bjerke, er forsvundet.

programme.title: Alena
programme.desc: Alenas liv udvikler sig til et sandt helvede, da hun bliver midtpunkt for ondskabsfuld mobning på den kostskole, hvor hun netop er startet. Veninden Josefin vil ikke lade sig og kue og vælger at tage kampen op for at hjælpe sin veninde.

programme.title: Pas på dit tørklæde, Tatjana
programme.desc: To mænd tager på en rejse gennem Finland med to russiske kvinder og oplever en række komiske og rørende hændelser.

programme.title: History Is Made at Night
programme.desc: En romantisk spændingskomedie om CIA-agenten Harry (Bill Pullman) og SVR-agenten Natasha (Irene Jacob), der kæmper for at redde verden, deres liv og hemmelige kærlighed i Helsinki efter den kolde krig.

programme.title: Broken Hill Blues
programme.desc: I et lille minesamfund i det nordlige Sverige kæmper en gruppe unge mennesker på vej til den voksne alder med dem selv og verden omkring dem, mens jorden rent bogstaveligt skælver under deres fødder.

programme.title: Som dag og nat
programme.desc: SOM DAG OG NAT er en komedie om kærlighed. Den handler om to søstre: den ene nyudnævnt borgmester i Stockholm, nyskilt og mor til to døtre.

programme.title: Leningrad Cowboys go America
programme.desc: Leningrad Cowboys, en gruppe sibiriske musikere, og deres manager rejser til Amerika på jagt efter berømmelse og formue. Mens de krydser landet, bliver de fulgt af landsbyidioten, som ønsker at blive medlem af bandet.

programme.title: Total Balalaika Show
programme.desc: En 57-minutters dokumentar om en koncert i Helsinki med Leningrad Cowboys og Alexandrov Red Army Choir and Ballet, som samarbejder om en række amerikanske rocksange sunget på engelsk samt traditionelle russiske sange.

programme.title: Sønnen fra vingården
programme.desc: Den pengegriske konsul Martin ejer sammen med sin strikse kone (Kirsten Rolffes) Vingården, der I følge et testamente efter "onkel Olsen", ikke må forlade familien Martins eje før 30 år efter hans død.

programme.title: The Quiet Roar
programme.desc: Et drama om en 68-årig kvinde, som diagnosticeres med en dødelig sygdom og derefter vælger at møde sin frygt genne en usædvanlig terapiform kombineret med indtag af et hallucinogent præparat.

programme.title: Carambole
programme.desc: En mand påkører en 14-årig dreng, der dør på stedet. Det er mørkt og regnfuldt, og manden flygter fra ulykkesstedet. En fejltagelse, han bittert kommer til atfortryde, og som forandrer hele hans liv.

programme.title: Manden uden fortid
programme.desc: En mand er på vej til Helsingfors for at søge job. Han er knap steget af toget før han bliver røvet og mishandlet. Da han kommer til sig selv, har han mistet alt, selv sin hukommelse. Uden navn og identitet må han begynde livet på ny.

programme.title: Laitakaupungin valot (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: En ensom nattevagt i Helsinki bliver involveret i en kriminel plan, der fører til hans undergang. Han forsøger at finde en vej ud af problemerne, men møder stadig flere udfordringer.

programme.title: Lindell - Nattens Søster - Del 2
programme.desc: Brenda Elise Moen bliver skuddræbt uden for sit hjem i Ullevål Hageby, tilsyneladende uden noget motiv. Cato Isaksen og hans team bliver sat på sagen. Efterhånden opdager politiet, at også Brenda Elises barnebarn, den 14-årige Kathrine Bjerke, er forsvundet.

programme.title: Pigen fra tændstikfabrikken
programme.desc: En kvinde, der arbejder på en tændstikfabrik, oplever en række uheldige hændelser, der fører til, at hun træffer en drastisk beslutning.

programme.title: Lindell: Drømmefangeren - Del 2

programme.title: The Quiet Roar
programme.desc: Et drama om en 68-årig kvinde, som diagnosticeres med en dødelig sygdom og derefter vælger at møde sin frygt genne en usædvanlig terapiform kombineret med indtag af et hallucinogent præparat.

programme.title: Sønnen fra vingården
programme.desc: Den pengegriske konsul Martin ejer sammen med sin strikse kone (Kirsten Rolffes) Vingården, der I følge et testamente efter "onkel Olsen", ikke må forlade familien Martins eje før 30 år efter hans død.

programme.title: Life Itself

En ung forfatter tvinges til at acceptere sin dødelighed; da han opdager; at han har en sjælden kræftform. Med hjælp fra sin bedste ven og en omsorgsfuld; ung terapeut finder han modet til at bekæmpe sygdommen.

programme.desc: Slevin (Josh Harnett) er knap nok rykket ind i vennen Nicks lejlighed før to gangsterbosser ønsker at ”tale” med ham. Eller: de ønsker at tale med Nick, og Slevin har svært ved at overbevise dem om at han ikke er Nick, da hans id er blevet stjålet.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: Familiebåndene sønderrives da Travis-familien rammes af en frygtelig tragedie. Ældste bror Matt begår selvmord, tilsyneladende uden grund. På desperationens rand kæmper far, mor og lillebror nu med en næsten uoverkommelig opgave: at genstarte

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Ægteparret Simon (Jason Bateman) og Robyn (Rebecca Hall) lever tilsyneladende det perfekte liv. Men da de ved et tilfælde støder ind i Simons gamle skolekammerat, Gordo (Joel Edgerton), begynder facaden langsomt at krakelere.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), en far, der ønsker at gøre oprør i sin søns (Jamie Andersons) øjne, forsøger at bringe Carden (Morgan Freeman), en snigmorder i verdensklasse, for retten. Hele tiden skal han beskytte sin søn og undgå snigmorderholdet, der metodisk jagter dem i vildmarken.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Gensyn med Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison finder ud af, at han har kræft og kun har nogle få uger tilbage at leve i. Hans voksne søn, Blake, rejser til Yorkshire for at bo hos sin mor i den by, han voksede op i. Efterhånden som Arthurs tilstand forværres, ser Blake tilbage på sit forhold til faren.

programme.title: What if
programme.desc: Den håbløse romantiker Wallace (Daniel Radcliffe) er droppet ud fra medicinstudiet og har brændt fingrene på kærligheden. Da han møder Chantry (Zoe Kazan) til en fest, er der kemi med det samme. Wallace falder for Chantry, men der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Det med at stifte familie er ikke lykkedes og de har besluttet sig for at være tilfredse med tilværelsen alligevel. Men alderskrisen kradser.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: I et skyggefuldt område af virksomhedsspionage snubler en kedet allemand ind i et net af bedrag og bliver en uvidende spion. Mens han navigerer i forræderi og forræderi, samarbejder han med en forførende gåde for at afsløre chokerende sandheder og genvinde sin identitet.

programme.title: Alright Now
programme.desc: En rockmusiker tilmelder sig universitetet efter at hun slår op med sin kæreste, og hendes band går i opløsning.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Kærlighed overvinder alt ... selv den uimodståelige trang til at spise din kærestes hjernemasse! I en ikke så fjern fremtid er jorden befolket af lige dele menneskeædende zombier og zombiebekæmpende mennesker.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: I The Beaver leverer Mel Gibson (dobbelt Oscar-vinder) en sublim skuespilspræstation som den depressive virksomhedsleder Walter Black, hvis familieliv, ægteskab og karriere skranter gevaldigt.

programme.title: Before Midnight
programme.desc: I "Before Midnight" møder vi parret Jesse og Celina næsten to årtier efter deres første møde på et tog mod Wien. Årene er gået, og nu bor de sammen i Paris.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Den succesrige restauratør Will Keane fylder snart 50 og lever et sorgfrit ungkarleliv. Da han møder Charlotte Fielding, en selvstændig ung kvinde, regner han med endnu en hurtig og let romance.

programme.title: The Dreamers
programme.desc: Tre kineaster – den amerikanske udvekslingsstudent Matthew og tvillingeparret Théo og Isabelle – er blevet venner via deres fælles interesse. Matthew er fascineret af Théo og Isabelles uortodokse intime bånd.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Da fire generationer af Cooper-klanen samles til en genforening, kommer en række uventede gæster og usandsynlige begivenheder til at vende op og ned på deres aften.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: Efter 28 dage i fængslet er Sin-Dee Rella tilbage på gaden. Hun er transkvinde og prostitueret og møder sin ven og kollega, Alexandra, som fortæller, at Sin-Dees kæreste og alfons har haft en affære i hendes fravær.
